subtasks.description: Add listTaskEvents to DbClient and add GET /:id/events route to src/web/routes/tasks.ts; wire db into createTaskRoutes in src/web/server.ts
testCriteria: GET /api/tasks/:id/events returns 200 with an array of objects each containing {id, type, agent, status, timestamp, elapsedSeconds, tokenUsage} for an existing task
GET /api/tasks/:id/events returns 200 with an empty array when no events exist for the task
Results are ordered by timestamp ASC
tokenUsage is an object {input, output} derived from token_input and token_output columns (null when both columns are null)
elapsedSeconds maps to elapsed_seconds column (null when not set)
type maps to event_type column
createTaskRoutes factory now accepts db as a third parameter and server.ts passes the db instance

subtasks.description: Add timeline component CSS to src/web/public/styles.css: timeline container, event rows with colored agent-type dots, elapsed/token metadata chips, and relative timestamp display
testCriteria: .event-timeline is a vertical list with a left-border connector line using var(--border)
.event-item has a flex row layout with a left dot indicator, main content area, and right-aligned timestamp

.event-dot is a small circle (10-12px) colored by data-agent attribute using CSS variables (e.g., data-agent='coder' maps to var(--accent), data-agent='reviewer' maps to var(--orange), data-agent='lead' maps to var(--yellow), others map to var(--text-dim))
.event-type is styled as the primary label (font-weight 500, var(--text))
.event-meta spans are styled as small pill/chip badges using var(--bg-surface-active) background and var(--text-muted) color
.event-timestamp is right-aligned, font-size 0.75rem, var(--text-dim)
Styles follow the existing CSS variable system and do not introduce hardcoded colors

subtasks.description: Update dashboard.js task detail rendering: fetch /api/tasks/:id/events and render a timeline in the #findings-section area, replacing the placeholder with a live event log
testCriteria: When a task detail panel opens, fetch(`/api/tasks/${id}/events`) is called and awaited

Each event renders inside #findings-section as an .event-item with: a .event-dot (data-agent set to event.agent), a .event-type label, optional .event-meta chips for elapsedSeconds and tokenUsage (only rendered when non-null), and a .event-timestamp showing a human-readable relative time (e.g. '2m ago', 'just now')
The #findings-section heading is updated to 'Pipeline Events' when the events endpoint is called
When the events array is empty, #findings-section shows a 'No events yet' message instead of an empty list
If the fetch fails, the section shows an error message rather than crashing
refreshTaskDetail re-fetches and re-renders events when called (e.g. on task.updated SSE)

subtasks.description: Review all changes for correctness, spec compliance, security, and UI quality
testCriteria: The GET /api/tasks/:id/events route uses parameterized queries (no SQL injection surface)
task_id binding in the SQL query uses the route param, not user-controlled body input
tokenUsage null-handling is consistent: both input and output null yields tokenUsage null; partial null returns object with null fields
Dashboard fetch error handling does not swallow exceptions silently
CSS classes introduced match exactly what dashboard.js emits in the rendered HTML
No regressions in existing task list, task detail, or findings display behaviour
